spans.s:
m. (-वः)
1 Flight, retreat.
2 Going upwards.
E.
उद् up, द्रु to run, and घञ् aff.

m. (-बः)
A loud noise.
E.
उद् before रु to cry, affix घञ्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-त)
1 Fled, retreated, run away.
2 Ascended, gone up or upwards.
E.
उद् and द्रुत gone.

(-द्रः)
An otter.
E.
उन्दी to wet, and रक Uṇādi aff.

m. (-ङ्गः)
An imaginary city, one floating in the air.
E.
उद् above, and द्रङ्ग a town, one द rejected; also read उद्रङ्क, see हरिश्वन्द्रपूर.

m. (-थः)
1 The pin of the axle of a carriage.
3 A cook.
E.
उद् up, and रथ a carriage.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
1 Distinct, evident.
2 Increased, augmented.
E.
उद्, रिच् to flow, affix क्त.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Destroying, breaking down.
E.
उद् on, रुज to injure, क aff.

Excess.
E.
उद्, रिच to flow, घञ् aff.
